s01-aerial.title: Aerial: drone over misty Nilgiri ridges, white church on a tea-estate hillside, eucalyptus/pine avenue, Ooty Lake far below, upright cross on the spire

s02-blessing.title: Blessing: tall carved white-stone cross with gold inlay on a stepped plinth, lanterns at its base, misty hilltop terrace, balustrade receding, clouds behind

s03-invitation.title: Invitation: high angle from the church steps down a long arched nave to an upright altar cross

s04-groom.title: Groom: long balustrade terrace receding into mist and pines, standing cross on a far plinth

s05-bride.title: Bride: long Gothic side hallway by a lancet window, arches receding, upright cross at the far end

s06-families.title: Families: ring-pillow vestry table at the end of a long cloister, small gold standing cross

s07-matrimony.title: Matrimony: couple at the altar of a very long nave, tall upright altar cross

s07b-ring-drop.title: Ring drop: close hands with a long nave and upright cross in bokeh behind

s08-venue.title: Venue: long jetty on misty Ooty Lake, white church small on a far hill with upright cross

s09-reception.title: Reception: misty hill-garden avenue of pines and fairy lights, cake stage, small upright white cross

s10-hosts.title: Hosts: series of floral arches receding to the church in the mist, standing cross

s11-save-date.title: Save the date: couple on a long misty Ooty Lake jetty, church and upright cross on the far hill

s12-forehead-touch.title: Forehead touch: same misty Ooty Lake jetty, upright cross on the far hill
